explanation: Many computer architectures execute bitwise operations (like shifts and additions) significantly faster than multiplication.  Optimizing code by replacing multiplication with equivalent bitwise operations improves performance by reducing execution time. This is particularly relevant for systems programming where performance is critical, and compilers may not always perform these optimizations effectively.
